title: Palavox lesson authoring file (schema v0.1)
description: One JSON file per lesson. Implements the lesson/exercise/vocab subset of the unified content-authoring schema v0.1 (docs/palavox-overhaul-plan/wip-07-08-consistency-report.md section 2), restricted to what the current DB schema (migration 20260729164446) can hold. Fields the DB cannot hold yet are either mapped by the seed generator (translations.es -> vocabulary.translation_l1) or carried as authoring-only metadata. Per-type structural rules (exactly one correct option, tokens for ordering, pairs for matching) are enforced by the deterministic validator gate G-keys, not by JSON Schema conditionals.

id.description: Lesson natural key, e.g. EN-U01-L05. Drives deterministic seed UUIDs.

skill_type.description: Must match public.skills.type CHECK constraint. The seed generator creates one skill row per skill_type used in the unit and attaches the lesson to it.

position.description: 1-based order within the unit; must match the lesson's index in the unit manifest lesson list.

est_minutes.description: Estimated core minutes. Band target is 8-18 (schema v0.1 lesson.est_minutes); the validator warns outside that range.

intro_md.description: Markdown intro rendered in the learner's L1. May contain {{l1_contrast:<target_id>}} slots. Maps to public.lessons.intro_md.

status.description: Authoring files are always draft in Phase 0. Promotion beyond draft happens only through the full gauntlet plus owner approval, never in the authoring file.

prerequisites.description: Authoring-only metadata for the future lesson_prereqs table (schema v0.1); not seeded today.

can_do_refs.description: Authoring-only pointers into can_do_statements; seeding the map is deferred until statements are seeded.

grammar_refs.description: Dotted grammar keys (e.g. gram.be.wh_questions). Authoring-only until grammar_points lands (plan 13 extension).

pron_refs.description: Dotted pron target keys. Authoring-only until pron_targets lands.

vocabulary_refs.description: Lemma keys of previously taught vocabulary this lesson recycles. Each must resolve to a new_vocabulary lemma of an earlier lesson in the unit (validator warns on unresolved refs; unresolved refs do NOT extend the allowed-lemma set).

new_vocabulary.description: Vocabulary items or chunks introduced by this lesson. These (plus prior lessons') define the G-vocab-boundary allowed set.

exercises.description: Ordered exercise sequence. G-counts enforces 6-14 per lesson (Phase 0 slice rule); schema keeps minItems 1 so partial drafts can still be schema-checked while failing G-counts honestly.

seq.description: Optional explicit sequence number; must equal 1-based array index when present.

prompt.description: Learner-visible prompt. Conventions: [L1: ...] segments render in the learner's L1; [audio, 0.75x] marks an audio play instruction. Bracketed segments are excluded from G-vocab-boundary scanning.

difficulty.description: 0-1 as stored in public.exercises.difficulty. G-difficulty requires first exercise <= last (warm-up ramp).

receptive_productive.description: receptive_to_productive (FSRS card-flip semantics, band file 13a) is authoring-level; the DB CHECK only allows receptive|productive, so the seed generator maps it to 'productive' with a TODO comment.

rationale.description: Author-facing pedagogical rationale for the exercise as a whole (why it exists here). Required by G-keys for every exercise: filler items with no articulable purpose must not pass.

options.description: Choice options (maps to public.exercise_options). Required for listening_mc. G-keys: exactly one is_correct=true, and that option must carry a rationale.

tokens.description: Scrambled tokens for ordering exercises (required for type=ordering; G-keys).

distractor_bank.description: Learner-visible wrong choices for cloze blanks; scanned by G-vocab-boundary.

expected_pattern.description: Speaking target pattern; {slot} placeholders are excluded from G-vocab-boundary scanning.

asr_focus.description: Author-facing ASR checks (not learner input; not vocab-scanned).

ai_interaction_ref.description: Reference to a (future) ai_interaction_specs contract for dialogue exercises. Authoring-only in Phase 0.

rationale.description: Why this option is right/wrong. REQUIRED on the correct option (G-keys hard fail); strongly recommended on distractors (G-keys warning).

lemma.description: Word or multiword chunk (chunks allowed, e.g. "Where are you from?"). Natural key for the vocabulary row (lowercased).

pos.description: Part of speech; 'chunk' for formulaic multiword items. Maps to vocabulary.part_of_speech.

translations.description: Keyed by BCP-47-ish L1 code. 'es' is REQUIRED for this slice; other L1s optional. The DB has only vocabulary.translation_l1 today: the seed generator writes translations.es there and emits a TODO for the vocabulary_translations extension (plan 13).
